page.overview:
What is Telepathy?

Telepathy, known to the Chiss as Second Sight, was the ability to mentally communicate and interact with other individuals, as well as to transmit and receive information to and from the minds of others.

Telepathy was the ability to mentally communicate and interact with other individuals through the Force, as well as to transmit and receive information to and from the minds of others.

Some Force-users were able to communicate with each other through the Force. Sometimes even those not born to the Force could be contacted with this art. Telepathy could be difficult for a Jedi to use.

Telepathy among the Chiss was known as Second Sight. The power typically manifested in young Chiss Force-sensitives around the age of ten and faded as they grew older, along with other Force powers. When used to touch the mind of another Chiss with the same power, Second Sight carried the risk that both would become lost in each other's minds.
